scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme
other_conditions: The applicant family should have been displaced from Jammu & Kashmir.
The applicant family should have migrated to Haryana from Jammu & Kashmir.
The applicant family should be residing in Haryana.
The term “Family” refers to the family of the applicant at the time of displacement from Jammu & Kashmir.
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 per family member for up to 5 years, capped at ₹6,250 per family per month.
